# `.claude/skills/` — generated by TuyaOpen IDE

Everything in this directory is **generated**. Each folder here is written
from the TuyaOpen skill catalogue every time a skill is installed or updated,
so any edit made here is replaced on the next install — it is not merged
anywhere and it is not read back.

**Edit `.agents/skills/<id>/` instead.** That copy is canonical: the IDE
checks it for local changes and asks before overwriting it, and this
directory is regenerated from the same source alongside it.

Folder names here are flattened (`.agents/skills/miniapp/foo/` mirrors to
`.claude/skills/miniapp-foo/`) because Claude Code reads this directory
exactly one level deep.

This file is written by the IDE and is not a skill.

---

# `.claude/skills/` — 由 TuyaOpen IDE 自动生成

本目录下的所有内容都是**自动生成**的。每次安装或更新技能时，IDE 都会依据
TuyaOpen 技能目录重写这里的文件夹，因此在此处所做的修改会在下次安装时被覆盖，
既不会被合并到别处，也不会被读回。

**请改为编辑 `.agents/skills/<id>/`。** 那是规范副本：IDE 会检查它是否有本地
改动，并在覆盖前询问；本目录会与它一起从同一来源重新生成。

此处的文件夹名是扁平化的（`.agents/skills/miniapp/foo/` 对应
`.claude/skills/miniapp-foo/`），因为 Claude Code 只读取本目录的第一层。

本文件由 IDE 写入，不是一个技能。
